updates.title: Car remote shell or a new key?
updates.text: Car remote shell or a new key? A cracked casing may need a replacement shell. We replace compatible car remote bodies and make or program keys and fobs for supported vehicles. Share the make, model, year and issue so we can confirm compatibility and a quote. Visit our shop on Gollahalli Main Road, Electronic City Phase 1.
updates.verification: Google Your posts explicitly displayed Published

updates.title: Sticking key or faulty door lock?
updates.text:
Sticking key or faulty door lock?

If your key is difficult to turn, avoid forcing it. We assess compatible door locks, cylinders, handles and bolts, and offer repair, replacement and installation for homes, offices and shops.

Shop visits and on-site service are available around Electronic City and our listed areas. We are open 24 hours. Contact us with the lock details and location to confirm suitable parts, availability and the quote, including any travel or installation charges.
updates.verification: Google Your posts explicitly displayed Published

offer.title: 10% off standard house-key duplication
offer.description: Save 10% on eligible standard house-key duplication at our Electronic City Phase 1 shop, with a maximum discount of ₹100 per order. Bring a compatible original key and show this Google offer or mention SPARE10 before placing your order.
offer.terms: Valid 22–31 October 2026, 00:00 on 22 October to 23:59 on 31 October, India time. Applies to ordinary mechanical edge-cut house-key duplication performed in the shop. Discount is 10% of the usual selling price for eligible key duplication, capped at ₹100 per order. Excludes car and bike keys, computerised/dimple/high-security keys, lock parts, programming, installation, call-out and travel fees. Cannot be combined with another offer. Bring a compatible original key; confirm eligibility and the final price before placing the order.
